Our Story

A Little Light, A Lot of Meaning.

At AURELLE, we believe that the smallest moments often become the most meaningful.

A quiet evening, a favourite book, a thoughtful gift, or simply a little time for yourself — every moment deserves a touch of warmth.

Born in Mumbai, AURELLE was created with a simple vision: to bring beauty, comfort and understated luxury into everyday living.

Our candles are thoughtfully crafted to create inviting spaces, meaningful rituals and memories that linger long after the flame goes out.

Because sometimes, all it takes is a little light to make a moment feel special.
